text:
## HOW RATES CHANGE  
### Monthly Rate Review Process  
**Date:** Mid-month (around the 15th)
**Trigger:** Bank of England Base Rate change or FirstUK strategic decision
**Effective:** 1st of following month  
**Customer Notification:**
- Email alert (if opted in)
- SMS notification (if opted in)
- Website update
- Branch notification (upon request)

raw_entities.description: Customer-facing guidance explaining how and when interest rates are reviewed and changed. The process occurs mid-month (around the 15th) and is triggered by Bank of England Base Rate changes or FirstUK strategic decisions, with new rates becoming effective on the 1st of the following month.
context: Trigger: Bank of England Base Rate change or FirstUK strategic decision

raw_entities.name: Rate Change Customer Notification
raw_entities.description: Guidance on how customers are notified of rate changes through multiple channels including email alerts (if opted in), SMS notifications (if opted in), website updates, and branch notifications upon request.

raw_entities.description: Operational action to assess whether a rate review should be triggered based on Bank of England Base Rate changes or FirstUK strategic decisions. Occurs mid-month around the 15th.
context: Trigger: Bank of England Base Rate change or FirstUK strategic decision

raw_entities.description: Mandatory action to communicate rate changes to customers through email, SMS, website, and branch channels based on customer preferences and opt-in status.
